# Job Website workspace instructions

- [x] Verify workspace instructions exist.
- [x] Clarify project requirements: React JavaScript frontend and Flask Python backend.
- [x] Scaffold the `frontend` and `backend` folders.
- [x] Customize and connect the frontend and backend.
- [x] Install required project dependencies; no additional editor extensions required.
- [x] Compile and validate the project.
- [x] Create and run the frontend build task.
- [x] Leave development servers stopped until the user chooses to launch them.
- [x] Complete project documentation.

## Development conventions

- Keep browser code in `frontend` and Flask API code in `backend`.
- Use JavaScript and React conventions in the frontend.
- Use the backend virtual environment at `backend/.venv` for Python commands.
- Keep API endpoints under `/api`; Vite proxies them to Flask during local development.
- Run frontend lint and build checks after frontend changes.
- Keep README setup and launch instructions current.
